hypotheses.reasoning: order-service v5.18.0 was rolled out at 05:01:27Z (#72) replacing v5.17.3, and became ready at 05:01:49Z (#77). From 05:02:48Z onward, POST /checkout requests fail with TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'locale') at format (order-formatter.ts:181) [v5.18.0] (#83, #92, #97). Those are the direct failures of the new code. Before the deploy, checkouts succeeded (#74, #81). The gateway 500s (#85, #104, #117, #122) are downstream symptoms of order-service returning 500 and are not cited as cause. Payment-svc, postgres, redis and order-consumer show no errors, which rules out the dependency-side explanations. The fault is in the formatter code path, which dereferences a missing object (likely a missing locale/config field on some orders) in v5.18.0. Only some requests hit it, which explains the partial 17% rate.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll back order-service from v5.18.0 to v5.17.3 now to restore checkout. Then fix order-formatter.ts:181 so it handles an undefined locale (default or guard), add a regression test for orders missing locale, and re-deploy after verification. Check whether the orders that hit the error (o-3792, o-3793, o-3795) have missing locale data upstream.
